brokerMetrics.title: Broker metrics
brokerMetrics.description: Data loss and delay through unclean leader elections and network throughput, and request failures through purgatories and timeouts.

consumerMetrics.title: Consumer metrics
consumerMetrics.description: Lag between production and consumption, delivery success and latency, and the volume consumed.

producerMetrics.title: Producer metrics
producerMetrics.description: Volume and rate of data sent to the brokers, and the success rate of message delivery.

brokerJVMMetrics.title: Broker JVM metrics
brokerJVMMetrics.description: Garbage collection, CPU and heap of the broker JVMs. Needs new_gc_metrics enabled.

partitionMetrics.title: Partition metrics
partitionMetrics.description: Partitions per topic, current and oldest offsets, and in-sync replicas.
